items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-15
items.q: I run across him every night, and then, yeah, he passes by my house.

ctx.x: He maybe do, but I haven't seen him play in a long time. Matter of fact, I haven't heard him play anything in a long time. I run across him every night, and then, yeah, he passes by my house. Mm-hmm. And then I had this fellow, T.O. used to play a lot of clarinet, too, with P. Ron. But he was mostly a reading man, to sit out and play that music.
Well, how did he do if he got in some Barrel House place and had to cut loose? Suppose he...
